'''Rattataki Block Alpha''' was a prison block for [[Rattataki/Legends|Rattataki]] prisoners located in the [[High Security Section]] of the [[Belsavis prison]]. It was located beneath the [[Republic watchtower]] on the eastern side of the High Security Section.
